from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its own title and its citation relationships with OTHER provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that this paper cites (from its reference list)")
    cited_by_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that cite this paper (may be empty per-document; filled by collection aggregation)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
